name: CAMPBELL, Julie-Ann

research_notes: Identify government department/office and political-staff versus public-service appointment, full employer/date chronology, EY start/end/legal entity and full-time/leave evidence. Seek historical employer biographies, government staffing records and AMWU annual reports. Resolve any earlier jobs and overlaps; no qualifying total supported yet.

2026-09-29 initial pass checked official APH, UQ's 2006 announcement, first speech, public speaker biography, AMWU primary release, 2023 and 2024 government diaries, candidate statements and contemporaneous party-departure reporting. EY identified through government records after broad professional-services searches. Admission to law in 2012 reported in secondary profiles is not an employment start.

Targeted professional-profile searches produced US Army, Queensland Health, Jamaica KPMG and NSW car-wash namesakes without identity linkage; none adopted. No full-time contracts or complete dates found. A 2022 EY appointment is a secondary press lead requiring employer/date verification; do not backdate from later diary observations.

Student office, AMWU work and party employment are excluded regardless of payment or hours. Government policy role remains unclassified pending its employing basis. EY associate-partner status does not prove full-time or self-employment; unknown is not zero. Two dated meetings are not a continuous employment interval.

Source access: April 2023 PDF web-reader failed; direct public PDF retrieval and pdftotext succeeded. Initial Python requests import was unavailable; standard-library retrieval worked. No access controls bypassed. All research remains blocked pending the recorded evidence gaps.

2026-10-02 follow-up: added primary 18 June 2015 AMWU meeting observation and separated UQ education from work. Searches for EY appointment, government department/office and 2009–11 chronology found no verified appointment basis or complete boundaries. The Australian public preview (https://www.theaustralian.com.au/nation/chief-aims-for-labor-resurrection-but-first-the-post-mortem/news-story/f4b3b8f881e39696e5602a2c9c4dd200) reports departure to EY but supplies no accessible decisive commencement day; preserve earlier 2022 appointment lead rather than backdate from later meetings. AustLII UQ history PDF returned 403. AMWU media releases are undated in rendered text; unrelated UK/NSW business and US research namesakes not adopted. Priority follow-up: EY dated appointment/cessation or public professional chronology, departmental versus ministerial staffing record, AMWU staff/annual-report chronology and individual hours/leave.
